GENERATE BURST L10fix-far-LR — Run C-9 P5 parallax repair (Matt R-C9-21: NOTHING may repeat). task_id "L10fix-far-LR".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (a window of a painted far-landscape parallax layer). On the RIGHT side of the image, on a steep rocky crag, stands a small burning GOTHIC CATHEDRAL with smoke — it is a DUPLICATE (the one true cathedral is elsewhere in the full layer). Remove the cathedral AND its crag completely: paint that area as the surrounding rolling hills, fields and trees continue, and remove its fire and smoke. Keep the one small town that sits to the left of it.
Change NOTHING else: every other pixel (hills, river, trees, small fires, the town, the flat pure #00ff00 above the horizon if any) stays exactly as it is, and the edges of the image must stay identical so the window pastes back seamlessly. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 1: do not restyle.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if the named building is still visible, anything else changed, or the image edges changed — name the reason. Copy the output to out/L10fix-far-LR.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L10fix-far-LR"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (remove only the duplicate)
